name: com.getmcpads/chatgpt-ads
title: ChatGPT Ads
description: ChatGPT Ads MCP server: 30 read tools, 28 opt-in preview-first writes.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Advertiser API key from Ads Manager settings. Scoped to one ad account. Keep it secret.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The adacct_ ID the key belongs to. The only account the server will use.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true exposes the write tools. Defaults to false. Writes preview before applying.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_ENABLE_ACTIVATION
environmentVariables.description: true allows activation, which can spend budget. Requires writes. Defaults to false.
